full_page.content:
1934, June
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO.5.
Page 100 June 21 Mrs. Teaporten - 50 - nervous brk .- down. Mrs . Hugh A. Courtney. ... (C-Palmer Patent)
John Regan - 48 - lip cancer ... has
Frances Gutowski - 40 - nervous - anxious about older brother away from Sacraments since mother died (26yrs.).
Genevieve Butler - 36 - cripple since birth. Mother now getting old wants to be cured to help along.
Alfred Shewell - 42 - paralyzed 4 mo. - has wife and little boy depending.
Mrs. Basara Quinkert - 55 - gastriti Julian Scotland - 11 - bursted appendix - two weeks in Rec. Hosp- ital.
Mrs. Moreau .... position To-morrow.
Page 201 June 28 Mrs. Ella Swift - 53 - blood-poisoned fingers - fears operation - widow with 7 boys. Enrolled To-day 50c - Promises weekly communion & perpetual Enrollment.
Paul Ostin - 37 - went for a job last Tuesday June 24th. . . has not been heard of since.
Miss Alice Nacy - 27 - poisoning from abcess in St. Mary's Hospita; .
Catherine M. Diroff - 40 - Husband & 9 ...
Edw'd Breight - 9 - born with defective arm .... Enrolled 5 yrs. ago - improved ... state Drs. want to operate .. mother fears ....
Mercy Hall Foundress - Miss Gibson
Mrs. Hugh McDonald - 23 = T.B. Herman Kiefer.
1934, July
Germaine Van Rykeyaln - 34 - Drs ...???
Page 202 July 4 7 George Duford -46 - had lost memory four years ago. Six months later lost job on that account .... was enrolled in Ser. Mass Ass'n day be- fore yesterday. X had been away from Sacraments 2 years (about he thinks)
